text:
A simple notice, before opening
An unusual month is easier with a plan
Travelers, check your pet details with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you head out.
Aurelia Skyways is keeping animal travel smooth, and our team wants every trip to start with calm, clear paperwork. If you are bringing a pet, please share the basics early and keep your message brief and respectful so staff can review comfort needs without delay. <<FACT F068>> We also note service changes in the desk ledger, so any update you give us should be easy to follow.

Every animal gets patient attention from trained staff, and the welfare coordinator will look over each case with care. If your plans change, send the update as soon as you can. That helps us keep the trip organized and avoids confusion at the airport.

For fast help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure.
